Iterators and generators

An iterator produces objects with value and done. A generator function can pause at yield and
resume on the next next() call.
Iterator එක data එක එකින් එක ලබාJදන interface එකක්. Generator function එක yield තැන
නවතා, next() මඟින් නැවත කික්‍රියාත්මක කළ හැකියි. සියලු values එකවර හදන්න අවශ්‍ය නැහැ.
Generate sequential invoice numbers on demand.
next() #1 next() #2 next() #3 · yield 1 / done: false yield 2 / done: false done: true

Interview question: What is the benefit of a generator?
Answer: It can produce values lazily and preserve execution state between yields.
Practice: Write a generator that yields three even numbers.
